about: Frozen cases for the request screen. The rule author wrote the 24 tuning cases and the 16 author_check cases on Nov 15, 2026, before the screening rules existed, and tuned version 1 of the rules on the tuning cases. A separate agent then wrote the 48 held_out cases from the written policy alone, without seeing the rules or the code. Version 1 was scored on them once, 35 of 48, and version 2 of the rules was tuned on those misses. A second separate agent wrote the 48 held_out_2 cases the same way, and version 2 was scored on them once. Labels stand as their authors wrote them.
